paragraphs: Arrive at the hangar before dawn to receive the overnight aircraft and review fault codes and work cards. During the day, remove boxes, measure wiring, replace parts, and test each item. Complete and sign work cards in the afternoon and support engine runs. Scheduled-maintenance periods involve continuous shifts with every action documented.

In one sentence: repair aircraft until they can fly safely. Work includes disassembly and inspection, wiring tests, part replacement, functional testing, work-card signoff, and scheduled maintenance. It combines analysis with hands-on work as the ground-based gatekeeper of flight safety.
